design_description: A bold football jersey designed for Port Talbot United, featuring a black base with striking orange and charcoal-grey chevron patterns across the front and back. Sharp, layered zigzag graphics create a dynamic, aggressive look, balanced by crisp white collar and sleeve trims. The front displays the club crest, Momuto branding, and the Your Wealthcare Financial Planning sponsor in white. The back features bold white PLAYER lettering and an oversized number 10, ensuring strong contrast against the energetic geometric pattern.
